faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 4.4 V8 petrol engine in the Land Rover Discovery 3. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a Range Rover V8 engine fit my Discovery 3?
faqs.a: Sometimes, but not without checks. Range Rover and Jaguar V8 engines can differ in ancillaries, wiring and calibration, so we compare your VIN and engine code with any replacement before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt Discovery V8 engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing V8. We recommend an option after assessing the fault.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 3 V8 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the Discovery 3 engine replacement cost for a 448PN?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any cooling or ancillary parts needed and the labour involved, including body-lift work. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 448PN engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Land Rover V8 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 448PN engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your Discovery V8?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 3 guide the decision. Coolant pipe, coil, sensor and gasket faults can usually be repaired individually. If timing chain failure or severe overheating has damaged the engine, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 3 448PN engine replacement is often more practical.
paragraphs: Overheating is a leading cause of V8 damage, and body-lift access makes it sensible to check related parts at the same time. Where relevant, we inspect the radiator, water pump, coolant pipes and thermostat, check the ignition system and gearbox, and renew all fluids.

Send your registration or VIN with a brief description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery V8 Engine Problems
engineProblems.description: The 4.4 V8 usually gives early warning signs, and prompt investigation can prevent serious internal damage.

cards.title: Secondary Chain Tensioner Noise
cards.description: A rattle on cold start, uneven idle or camshaft timing fault codes can point to worn secondary tensioners, guides or stretched timing chains. We inspect the tensioners, guides and camshaft timing.

cards.title: Coolant Crossover and Hose Leaks
cards.description: Coolant loss, a sweet smell or damp patches can come from ageing plastic coolant pipes, the crossover pipe or perished hoses. We pressure-test the cooling system to find leaks.

cards.title: Radiator and Water Pump Faults
cards.description: Rising temperature when towing, steam or coolant loss at the front may indicate a failing water pump, a thermostat fault or a blocked radiator. We check pump condition and cooling performance.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Spark Plug and Coil Wear
cards.description: Juddering, a flashing engine light or rough idle are often caused by worn spark plugs or failing ignition coils on the V8. We test each coil and spark plug.

cards.title: Camshaft Timing and Sensor Faults
cards.description: Hesitation, uneven running or timing-related fault codes may relate to variable camshaft timing components, camshaft sensors or degraded engine oil. We read live data and test the sensors.

cards.title: Rocker Cover and Seal Leaks
cards.description: Oil seeping onto the exhaust, burning smells or smoke from the engine bay may come from hardened rocker cover gaskets or ageing seals. We locate the leak and inspect the seals.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 3 448PN Engine: Your Complete V8 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 3 448PN engine is the 4.4-litre V8 petrol from Jaguar Land Rover's AJ-V8 family, fitted to petrol V8 versions of the Discovery 3. Smooth and capable, it is now ageing, and timing chain wear, coolant leaks, misfires and oil leaks often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Land Rover Discovery V8 engine shares its design with V8s used in the Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Jaguar models, but the ancillaries and calibration differ. We identify the correct engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Discovery 3 448PN engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
